generated.brand-mark.description: A mark generated for, or supplied by, the new page's owner.

placeholder.brand-mark.description: A neutral geometric placeholder mark (e.g. two strokes) with no source shape.

generated.name-lettering.description: The new owner's name set in the licensed serif (licensed-or-fallback.font), fitted full-bleed.

generated.signature.description: A procedurally generated pen line; never traced from a real signature.

user.portrait-photo.description: A portrait the new page's owner supplies of themselves, with consent. Never a stock or third-party likeness.

generated.portrait-silhouette.description: The neutral generated head-and-shoulders silhouette (data.js drawPortrait) or another non-identifying figure.

generated.work-visual.description: Procedurally drawn or newly generated work imagery (logos, boards, mockups) with no client marks.

user.work-media.description: The new owner's own work images or videos, supplied by them.

licensed-or-fallback.font.description: Instrument Serif (OFL) / Inter Tight (OFL), as the clone ships them.

icon.ui.description: The clone's own 14px stroke icons (arrow, chevron, cross, rewind, link).

placeholder.url.description: Links on reserved domains only (.example, .invalid, example.com/.org/.net), relative paths, query strings or anchors.

original.copy.description: Newly written copy for the new owner; no source sentence or 6-word window.

fictional.person.description: Fictional owner / client names. The source has no avatars, reviewer photos or testimonials (grep of the snapshot), so no avatar role exists.

placeholder.metric.description: Fictional counts (pieces, projects, years). Stands in for the source's real claims ('1,067 works', 'fourteen years'); the source has no ratings or reviews, so this is the rating/metric placeholder.
